text: We also looked at what your store already runs. Klaviyo for email. Your list keeps growing from sign ups in the app. Instafeed. Your Instagram feed gets its own place in the app. GA4 for analytics. App events flow into the reports you already read. Nothing gets replaced and nothing needs to be rebuilt.
